messages:
nora: Heads-up: rolling a small canary (kestrel-int8 streaming + KV-cache). Observing intermittent funcall schema rejects.
ashwin: Repro locally. Validator fails because keys contain invisible/ZW chars. Example literal stream snippet: `{"tool":"run","args":{"ste\u200Dp":1}}` — note the zero-width joiner inside the key name.
marta: Frequency low but consistent: ~0.12% over 40k calls. triage-bot fired.
ingrid: Hypothesis: quant token boundary split injects ZW chars, compounded by prefixing from KV-cache.
ashwin: Short term: proxy sanitizer that removes ZW chars from keys and trims control chars around chunk joins. Also add metric `funcall_zw_pct`.
marta: Also add a coercion fallback for numeric fields (e.g., try int() if schema rejects) and log when coercion applied.
nora: Experiment plan: A/B 20% sanitizer vs control; synthetic 100k stream invokes across int8/q4f16/fp16 to bucket by chunk count and response length.
ashwin: I'll open PR for sanitizer + unit tests + fuzz harness (ETA EOD). Will include raw byte samples.
ingrid: Long term: file ISSUE-ml-kernel-token-split for runtime/tokenizer team to avoid embedding ZW chars; also add kernel test to avoid emitting those codepoints.
triage-bot: alert: funcall-zw-suspect 0.12% (kestrel-int8) — monitoring enabled.
marta: Add idempotency guard on proxy to avoid duplicate tool execution on client retry until kernel fix lands.
nora: Thanks team. If sanitizer drops errors we'll roll to wider canary and schedule kernel fix. :thumbsup:
